# Better Dungeons Agent Skills Catalog

This folder contains focused SKILLS.md files for common change types.

- change-workflow/SKILLS.md: End-to-end implementation workflow for safe feature changes.
- dungeon-generation-core/SKILLS.md: Grid, rooms, smoothing, and generation pipeline updates.
- hallway-and-connectivity/SKILLS.md: Hallway carving and reachability logic updates.
- performance-and-determinism/SKILLS.md: Seed stability, runtime cost, and memory behavior.
- docs-and-demo/SKILLS.md: README and docs demo synchronization.
- release-and-compatibility/SKILLS.md: Public API, package metadata, and release safeguards.

Use the most specific skill first, then combine with change-workflow/SKILLS.md for execution order.
